description: Carbon expense tracker for sustainability officers — log emissions across scope 1/2/3 categories, track against reduction budgets, and reconcile offsets

pages.name: dashboard
pages.description: Overview of the organisation's carbon ledger for the current reporting period
components: Left sidebar with the workspace name and a reporting-period switcher at the top, then a vertical nav (Dashboard, Ledger, Categories, Offsets, Suppliers, Reports), then a footer block with the current user and an org-switcher
Top bar in the main area with a page heading 'Q3 2025 Carbon Ledger', a date-range picker, a scope filter chip group (Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3), and a primary 'Log emission' button
Row of four KPI tiles — Gross emissions tCO2e, Offsets retired tCO2e, Net position tCO2e, Budget remaining — each tile showing the value, a delta vs prior period, and an inline sparkline

Two-column block: a stacked-bar chart on the left showing weekly emissions broken down by scope with a legend underneath, and a budget-burn-down chart on the right plotting cumulative emissions against the linear reduction target with a variance band
Recent activity table at the bottom with columns Date, Source, Category, Scope, Activity data, Emission factor, tCO2e, Status, and a row-action menu

pages.name: ledger
pages.description: Searchable, filterable transactional ledger of every logged emission line
components: Same left sidebar with 'Ledger' marked active
Filter bar across the top with a search input, multi-select dropdowns for Scope, Category, Facility, and Supplier, an emission-factor-source dropdown, and a 'Verified only' toggle
Bulk-action toolbar showing selected-row count, a 'Recalculate factors' action, an 'Export CSV' action, and an 'Assign to report' action

Ledger table with sortable columns Date, Description, Facility, Scope/Category, Activity quantity, Emission factor with source tag, tCO2e, and a verification-status badge, plus a totals row summing tCO2e for the filtered view
Pagination footer with rows-per-page selector, page navigation, and a 'Showing X of Y lines' counter

pages.name: log-emission
pages.description: Form for entering a new emission line and previewing its calculated impact
components: Same left sidebar
Page heading 'Log emission' with a breadcrumb Ledger / New entry and a 'Save draft' secondary button

Left-column form with sections for Source (date, description, facility dropdown, supplier autocomplete), Classification (scope radio cards, category picker, GHG gas multi-select), and Activity data (quantity, unit, document upload)

Right column live-preview panel showing the matched emission factor card (factor value, unit, source database, vintage year, region), a computed tCO2e readout updated as inputs change, an uncertainty range bar, and a note field for assumptions
Sticky action bar at the bottom with 'Cancel', 'Save and add another', and a primary 'Save entry' button

pages.name: offsets
pages.description: Portfolio view of purchased carbon offset credits and retirement status
components: Same left sidebar with 'Offsets' active
Header strip with three summary tiles — Credits owned, Credits retired this period, Coverage ratio (retired vs gross emissions) shown as a horizontal progress bar with a target marker
Project portfolio grid (three per row) where each card shows project name, registry badge, project-type icon, vintage year, credits held, price per tonne, and a 'Retire credits' action
Retirement history table with columns Date retired, Project, Vintage, Credits (tCO2e), Reporting period, Serial-number range, and Certificate link

pages.name: suppliers
pages.description: Directory of upstream suppliers and their reported Scope 3 contributions
components: Same left sidebar with 'Suppliers' active
Page heading 'Suppliers' with an 'Invite supplier' primary button and a 'Request disclosures' secondary button
Filter row with search, industry dropdown, disclosure-status chip group (Disclosed, Pending, Estimated, No data), and a data-quality-score range slider
Supplier table with columns Supplier, Industry, Spend, Estimated tCO2e, Disclosed tCO2e, Data-quality tier badge A–E, Last update, and an expand control that opens an inline category breakdown panel

pages.name: reports
pages.description: Reporting workspace for generating disclosure-ready exports
components: Same left sidebar with 'Reports' active
Framework selector tab bar across the top (GHG Protocol, CDP, CSRD/ESRS E1, TCFD, SBTi progress) with the active framework highlighted

Two-column body: left column lists report sections as a checklist (Boundary & methodology, Scope 1 inventory, Scope 2 location vs market, Scope 3 categories 1–15, Offsets & removals, Assurance) with completion status icons next to each
Right column shows the active section's content — a generated narrative block, a data table sourced from the ledger, and a 'Data lineage' link list pointing back to underlying entries
Bottom action bar with an export-format dropdown (PDF, XBRL, XLSX), a 'Send to auditor' secondary button, and a primary 'Lock and publish' button
